dialogue.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How can I help?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hello, Rachel. Adrian Lee speaking. I'm calling about the planned allocation, and I have my prepared order note in front of me. My identification number is F seven seven four five zero five four R. My date of birth is 28 August 1966.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Before we get into the note, you had wanted to discuss the presentation of your portfolio summaries. What would be most useful?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Keep the main summary concise, please, with the supporting material separate. I spend enough time reading consulting reports during the working day. I would rather have a short overview to work through before opening the detailed statements.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll note that presentation preference. For a future portfolio review, would a telephone conversation or a meeting be easier to arrange?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: A telephone conversation would be easier. My client meetings move around, so please send possible appointments by secure message. I can check my diary and reply there rather than settle a time now.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can arrange the review that way. Let's turn to what you called about.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The fund I want to transact in is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. I want to buy, please. My overall account value is 1,200,000 euros; that is portfolio context, not the amount I am investing here. The allocation of 500,000 euros was only a hypothetical planning illustration, not my instruction for this transaction.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll attend to the order administration. Please check your secure messages for the related correspondence, and I'll also send the proposed review appointments there.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thank you, Rachel. That keeps the correspondence together. I'll look out for the appointment options when I'm back at my desk. Goodbye.
